svg.title: Crystal Essence — Prism and Lattice. Fable proposal — 2026-10-04 batch rebalance / Crystal classification / forked tree.
svg.desc: 10 skills, 4 purchases, one Advanced Art maximum. Prismatic Focus forks into Razor Lattice then Splintered Mountain Heart, or Flaw in the Stone then Break Along the Flaw. Jade Lattice forks into Flawless Sphere then Adamant Core, or Light Turned Back then Entombed in Crystal. No paths converge. Bonuses apply to matching supported tags on all Crystal jutsu.

Prismatic Focus answers \"How do I make my Crystal strikes count: sharpen myself or crack them open?\" (Shipp\u016b self buff 35 \u2192 45%, or both exposure marks 35 \u2192 43%). Jade Lattice answers \"How do I hold my ground: endure the blows or turn them back?\" (Sphere Decrease Damage Taken 35 \u2192 45%, or Cave Reflect 40 \u2192 50%). BUFF","adverse":false,"base":40.0,"gain":10,"final":50.0,"calculation":"percentage","supported":true,"capped_at_100":false}],"advanced_arts":["Entombed in Crystal"]}],"design_notes":["Batch rebalance (2026-10-04): the +5 Damage route (Prism 50 \u2192 55, Shipp\u016b and Cave 40 \u2192 45) and the Razor Lattice +2 Damage fourth purchase (Prism 50 \u2192 52) are removed, because every flat Damage total lifts Prism past the 50 Nuke tier. Razor Lattice and Splintered Mountain Heart now carry Increase Damage Given (+3%, +5%), and the +3% Increase Damage Given riders on Break Along the Flaw, Adamant Core and Entombed in Crystal are removed as shared glue. Maxima over every legal allocation: Increase Damage Given +10%, Increase Damage Taken +8%, Decrease Damage Taken +10%, Reflect +10%, no Damage.","Magnitudes follow leverage, not printed totals. Increase Damage Given has one row, but it multiplies every matching hit the caster lands in the two rounds after Shipp\u016b (\u00d71.35 \u2192 \u00d71.45; the bloodline passive multiplies last), so it takes the full +10%. Increase Damage Taken has two rows from two casts that amplify every attacker's matching hits and compound on a doubly marked enemy (\u00d71.82 \u2192 \u00d72.04), so it stops at +8%. Decrease Damage Taken +10% (a hit taken \u00d70.65 \u2192 \u00d70.55) and Reflect +10% (40 \u2192 50% returned) each move about a tenth of every hit taken in their window.","Narrow coverage: Increase Damage Given, Decrease Damage Taken and Reflect have one row each. Each capstone stays single-tag because the only remaining secondaries are a sibling Hidden Art's tag (a capstone plus that Hidden Art would stack it) or the other Foundation's tags (which would blur the offense/defense split).","Fourth purchases: Burst window (01, 02, 03) adds Flaw in the Stone (marks 40%) or Jade Lattice; Exposure (01, 04, 05) Razor Lattice (Shipp\u016b 40%) or Jade Lattice; Fortress (06, 07, 08) Light Turned Back (Reflect 45%) or Prismatic Focus; Retaliation (06, 09, 10) Flawless Sphere (Decrease Damage Taken 40%) or Prismatic Focus. The two all-offense builds (01, 02, 03, 04 and 01, 02, 04, 05) land within 1% of each other on a doubly marked enemy in the Shipp\u016b window (\u00d71.45 \u00d7 1.40 \u00d7 1.40 \u2248 \u00d72.84 against \u00d71.40 \u00d7 1.43 \u00d7 1.43 \u2248 \u00d72.86) and differ in whose hits they amplify, so neither dominates.","Filters and delivery: Shipp\u016b's self buff (Crystal/Earth/Fire/None, Ninjutsu filter) amplifies any Ninjutsu hit and any Crystal, Earth, Fire or element-less hit of any stat type; Sphere's mark (Ninjutsu, no element) any Ninjutsu or element-less hit; the Cave's mark Crystal, Earth, Fire or element-less hits. Every jutsu has cooldown 7; Shipp\u016b and the Cave are 60 AP circle spawns, Prism a 60 AP single shot, the Sphere a 40 AP single cast. Rows are live in the two rounds after their cast round, and SELF rows land on the caster at cast time once the cast has a legal target. Pierce ignores every modifier here except Reflect.","Untouched rows: the three Damage rows are unamplified in this revision; Prism's wound and the Jade summon are unsupported. Skill-tree effects and passives are skipped in RANKED_PVP and RANKED_SPARRING."],"risks":["Classification: Crystal is shared with Sea-Maiden's Kiss (expected under RUL-2026-10-03-005). 5 of 8 kit rows carry Crystal; Crystal Sphere's two rows and Crystal Cave's Reflect row need the proposed jutsu-classification resolver, and Crystal Sphere qualifies only through an authored Crystal jutsu classification (ENGINE_GAP_REGISTER G1). Off-kit Crystal coverage is unverified.","Exposure breadth: at +8% both marks are 43% for two rounds and amplify allies' matching hits as well as the caster's (pierce excluded); a doubly marked enemy takes \u00d71.43 \u00d7 1.43 \u2248 \u00d72.04 against \u00d71.82 unmodified. Team value was not simulated.","Increase Damage Given stacking: Shipp\u016b's 45% compounds with any main-tree or item Increase Damage Given, and the bloodline passive (about 28.75% at level 25) multiplies last (\u00d71.45 \u00d7 1.29 \u2248 \u00d71.87 in the window). The window's realized value depends on landing Prism or the Cave inside it.","Reflect cap and uptime: 50% leaves ten points under the 60%-of-hit cap, but main-tree or item Reflect could saturate it. Reflect pays only when the caster is hit in the two rounds after a 60 AP Cave cast, and Decrease Damage Taken active at the same time lowers what is reflected.","Friendly fire: Crystal Sphere is an OTHER_USER single cast whose mark (friendly fire none = ALL) lands on an ally if the Sphere targets one, up to 43% on the Exposure route; its Decrease Damage Taken window also needs a legal target in range 4. Shipp\u016b's and the Cave's damage and the Cave's mark reach only enemies.","Skill-tree effects are skipped in RANKED_PVP and RANKED_SPARRING. g.text: Foundations support. Hidden Arts focus. Advanced Arts define.
1 BP each · Acquire points with silver
Bonuses apply to matching supported tags on all Crystal jutsu. Combat scopes stay unchanged.
Finish a path in 3 purchases. Spend your fourth on support or a sibling Hidden Art.
Any two Advanced Arts require at least 5 points. Your limit is 4.
Each skill purchased once · Only your current bloodline unlocks · No converging paths
Examples are choices, not locked presets. Advanced Arts are optional.
Splintered Mountain Heart path + Flaw in the Stone
Break Along the Flaw path + Jade Lattice
Adamant Core path + Light Turned Back
Entombed in Crystal path + Prismatic Focus
IDG: Increase Damage Given · IDT: Increase Damage Taken · DDT: Decrease Damage Taken · REF: Reflect
FINAL TAG VALUES ON THE CRYSTAL ESSENCE KIT
Jutsu level 25 · main-tree bonuses and bloodline passives excluded
Static bonuses: a 35% tag with +5% becomes 40%. A 40 EP jutsu with +5 Damage becomes 45EP.
Lifesteal shares a 60%-of-hit leech budget with vamp; Reflect returns at most 60% of a hit.
Proposed behavior: needs a jutsu-classification potency resolver. The current resolver matches each effect's own elements.
14 legal four-skill allocations · 4 Advanced Arts available · Combat tuning remains experimental
Fable proposal — 2026-10-04 batch rebalance / Crystal classification / forked tree
